sentences.en: Hong Kong is referred to as the Pearl of Asia.
sentences.zh: 香港被称为亚洲的明珠。

sentences.en: I gave my sister a pearl necklace on her birthday.
sentences.zh: 我在姐姐生日时送了她一条珍珠项链。

sentences.en: He wants to buy a pearl necklace for his wife.
sentences.zh: 他想给妻子买条珍珠项链。
